name: Header
description:
Component: al-header

The site header landmark and its chrome. Header owns the `<header>` element,
the opt-in sticky/elevated behaviour and the stacking context. Arrangement is
`<al-layout>`'s job — nest one and lay the bar out there.

```html
<al-header sticky elevated>
  <al-layout direction="row" align="center" justify="between">
    <al-logo></al-logo>
    <al-menu>...</al-menu>
    <al-layout direction="row" gap="sm">...actions...</al-layout>
  </al-layout>
</al-header>
```

See "Arrangement vs. semantics" in AGENTS.md.

props.name: elevated
props.description: Cast a shadow under the bar to separate it from the content it scrolls over.

props.name: sticky
props.description: Stick the header to the top of its scroll container.

slots.description: The header content. Wrap it in an `<al-layout>` to arrange it.
